style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon, Ecomonos style, PURE WHITE background, thick black ink outlines, flat colors. A brown cartoon monkey protagonist, huge white round eyes, exactly like the reference image. Exactly two arms and two hands per character. Any text that appears in the image must be in PERFECT SPANISH, never English. Fill the whole frame, no black bars. SCENE: CRITICAL: NEVER draw a calendar, a torn-calendar page, or any counter of days/DIAS with a number on it (258, 250, or any other number) unless the scene explicitly and specifically asks for a day-counter — this motif does not belong in this video and must never appear as a default way to depict remembering/thinking/time passing. CRITICAL about the shadow-hacker attacker: its face must ALWAYS stay completely hidden inside the black hood shadow — never draw visible skin, a nose, a mouth, teeth or any facial features, and never let it look like the brown monkey wearing a hoodie. Only two glowing YELLOW eyes are visible, nothing else. Show emotion only through posture, hands, and the shape/angle of the two eyes.

frames.text: Hay siete cosas que casi todo el mundo crees sobre seguridad informática,

frames.text: y las siete son mentira, o casi.

frames.text: Vamos a desmontarlas una por una, y al final vas a hacer al menos una cosa distinta hoy mismo.

frames.text: El modo incógnito te esconde de todo Internet.

frames.text: La realidad es que el modo incógnito solo borra tu historial local en tu propio ordenador.

frames.text: Si la web tiene el candado verde, es una web segura.
